newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK stocks seen moving up on follow-through buying.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks seen moving up on follow-through buying.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks are expected to continue heading into record ground on Thursday after Standard & Poor's lifted sentiment by upgrading its rating on Hong Kong and a string of blue-chip companies, brokers said.

"Sentiment is very bullish since other markets in the region look weak," said Peter Lui, institutional sales trader at NAVA SC Securities. "Follow-through buying from yesterday is expected but the pace of the rise may slow a bit."
The Hang Seng Index rose 247.12 points, or 1.78 percent, to end at a record high of 14,153.58 on Wednesday. The Hang Seng London Reference Index later added 40.05 points to 14,193.63.
